name: Nina Chatu
role: Merchant broker; later Bendahara under Portuguese rule
bio: A letter carried through Chatu’s contacts may reach a prisoner when a direct petition cannot. The same network can arrange trade after authority changes hands.
notes: fact: The accounts describe his aid to Portuguese captives and later office, not a pre-fall shahbandar appointment (Pires II, pp. 258, 265, 281; Birch III, pp. 44–46, 128–129)
inference: The date and manner of his death are disputed; Pires reports grief and poison, and Cortesão discusses later accounts (Pires II, pp. 287–288 and editorial notes; people-factions.md §2)
gameplay: Consignment covers and Kannan’s patronage are invented (people-factions.md §2; port-labour.md §4)
